verdicts.reason: Both are unusable: the headline, the URL and the HO SMART wordmark are missing, so no message remains. The hand photo has shrunk to a thin strip next to an empty grey bar, and the white device-logo outline floats oversized on a white background with almost no contrast. The two layouts are nearly identical. B is marginally less bad only because its blue band sits closer to the photo row, which leaves slightly less dead space between them. In A the band floats alone in the upper third.
